purpose: Reviewed, path-scoped exceptions for scripts/ci/secret-scan.mjs. An empty list means every scanner rule applies to every tracked file. An allowlist entry never suppresses a whole rule globally: it must name a concrete repository-relative path and a concrete rule id, and the finding is still printed as an allowlisted match.

entrySchema.path: Repository-relative POSIX path of the tracked file, exactly as `git ls-files` prints it.
entrySchema.reason: Why the match at this path is not a credential, in one factual sentence.
entrySchema.approvedBy: Name of the reviewer who accepted the exception.
